derivation: The inner expansion's source collection lists two objects in an order that is not the raw UTF-8 order of their obligation identifiers. Two different sentences govern the two lists that result. COMPOSITION states that each fan-out pass retains source order in object_keys and obligation_ids, so the pass row keeps the collection's order. LIFE-019 states that child-pass obligation IDs use raw UTF-8 order, and the parent obligation's waiting reference is exactly a child-pass reference, so its obligation_ids are the same two identifiers sorted. Everything else follows FAN-001 for a successful nonempty expansion: one object occurrence and obligation per key in source order, the parent moved to WAITING on the exact reference in the same transition, and a MATCHED effect with an empty reason set whose ROUTE names only the inner fan-out.
